description:
Are you ready to level up from analytics engineering into context engineering? In this demo, I take my local Claude Code and Codex chat transcripts, load them into Snowflake, and use the dbt_context_engineering package to chunk, embed, and search them, then have dbt Wizard write a skill from what we found.

🔗 Links
dbt_context_engineering package: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-context-engineering
Example repo from this video: https://github.com/C00ldudeNoonan/dbt-chat-context-eng
Wizard Desktop (beta, join the waitlist): https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/dbt-ai/wizard-desktop

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Analytics engineering → context engineering
0:07 Just-in-time vs. just-in-case context
0:26 Warehouse AI functions and classic search techniques
0:48 The pipeline shape: extract, transform, chunk, embed, search
1:04 The dbt context engineering package
1:23 Demo: chat transcripts → Snowflake
1:54 Wizard Desktop setup
2:15 Summarizing sessions with AI
2:24 Parallel pipelines: testing chunk sizes
2:39 How embeddings and search work
3:19 Eval searches
3:25 Writing a SKILL.md from the results
3:31 Principles: sample, iterate, use your existing tools
3:57 Try the package

What's in the example repo
- Local ingestion with secret and email redaction before anything leaves your machine
- Chunking, classification, embedding, and vector search as ordinary dbt models
- Spend caps, dev sampling, and a run log for every AI call (AI is off by default)
- Incremental embedding: only new or changed chunks get re-embedded
- An eval set to compare chunk sizes on the same questions

The package is early and we're actively building it, so issues and pull requests are welcome.
